body:
## Stacking
This branch contains #99 (P1 availability logic) and #100 (P2 shell) because P3 needs both. Merge order: #99, #100, then this. Until then the diff against `dev` shows their commits too; the P3 work is the last two commits.

## What changed (`/student`, "My Space")
- **Greeting** with the year. The `Welcome back` heading is kept, so the pinned e2e heading check still holds.
- **Hero:** `Continue` appears only when the server confirms an open timed paper (`hasActiveSession`, and `ActiveSessionBanner` re-checks before drawing). Otherwise a single `Start practice` link. A disabled Continue is never drawn, and a practice set is never offered as resumable. The text says a practice set has no timer and starts again from question 1 if the tab closes; it does not say "saved".
- **Pathways:** from `getStudioAvailability()` (PROGRAMS + `resolveProgramStatuses`), the student's own year, ready subjects only. "There is no practice available for Year N yet" and "We couldn't check what practice is available right now" are separate states; the second shows no counts and no links. No copy says content is checked, reviewed or approved.
- **My Progress panel:** says what it is worked out from ("your N finished timed papers. Practice sets are not recorded"), shows marks earned out of marks available per subject, and withholds a subject below the D6 threshold (2 papers and 8 marks, in one shared module `progress-threshold.ts` for the parent screens to import). No percentages, rings, streaks, XP or mastery language.
- **Recent activity** (heading kept for the pinned e2e check): latest three finished papers with title (h3), answered count, date, and the score as "% of the marks that could be marked", or "No marks to show yet". A paper with questions awaiting a person says "some questions not yet marked", never zero.
- Page is `force-dynamic`; the existing `loading.tsx` and `error.tsx` cover loading and error.

## Placeholders removed from this page
The page no longer renders `DashboardHero` (pace/difficulty chips), `AccessCardsSection` (second metric), `DashboardWelcomeBanner` (academic session, curriculum-sync badge, interests/goal), `QuickActionsSection`, `ExploreGridSection` or `RecentActivityCard`. Those component files still exist, are no longer used by any page, and are left for a follow-up deletion so this PR doesn't touch their tests.

## Deviations to know about
1. **No "Review answers" link.** There is no per-attempt review route (P10). The link is "Open My Results" (`/results`). Drawing a review link would be a dead end.
2. **Marks line is a percentage, not "X of Y".** `AttemptSummary` carries no marks earned/available (B4). P10 fixes the type; the My Progress panel does use marks, from `aggregateMastery`.
3. **Continue shows no "saved on our server at ..." time or "N answered".** The resume payload (`ActiveSessionResponse`) has no server-confirmed save timestamp, so I draw none rather than invent one. It does carry `responses` and `currentQuestionIndex`; wiring an answered count into the existing recovery banner is a small follow-up if you want it.
4. First-time student sees the hero, pathways, and empty progress/recent states. There is no separate first-run illustration.

## Open items carried forward
- `/results` leaves the student shell (from #100); decide at P10.
- Dead dashboard components (above).

## Tests
- New `my-space.test.tsx` (15): Continue only when confirmed and never disabled; no "saved" claim; first-time heading; ready/none/unknown pathway states with no counts or links when unchecked; no approval language; progress threshold withheld/shown; no %, streak, XP in the panel; not-yet-marked never zero; no dead review link; max three recent.
- `tsc` clean; eslint clean on touched files; 80 tests pass across student, navigation-graph, my-space and practice-studio files.
- **Not run here:** full `npm test` (the last run was stopped by the host for low memory), build, `test:rls`, `test:e2e`, `test:e2e:auth`. The pinned e2e checks I kept compatible are `/Welcome back/`, `Recent activity`, the `h3` attempt title, and the `My Learning — Dashboard` title; none executed.

## UNVERIFIED
Visual layout at 320-1023px; the dashboard e2e fixtures against the new page.
